note: Action choices match the leader's recorded goal. Availability comes from each canonical action writer, not a place-specific branch or a turnout target.

actions.label: Circulate a petition
actions.description: Ask residents to sign the proposition through the petition engine.

actions.label: Organize a protest
actions.description: Invite residents to a recorded public protest.

actions.label: Organize a letter drive
actions.description: Ask residents to write to the responsible officials.

actions.label: Endorse a candidate
actions.description: Record support through the existing endorsement writer.

actions.label: Give testimony
actions.description: Speak on the recorded item at the relevant hearing or meeting.

actions.label: Bring a lawsuit
actions.description: File the group's claim through the court process.
